title: Shared denominator
mechanism: Signed logits become positive exponential mass; all classes use one shared total; the final probabilities occupy one fixed capacity with total 1.
visual_checks: Negative logit remains distinguishable before exp
All three masses contribute to the denominator
Total-one constraint is visible through shared geometry
Class colors and identities survive each transformation

title: Identity survives
mechanism: One identity path transports x unchanged while another computes F(x); only at the merge do the corresponding components add to y = x + F(x).
visual_checks: Identity path does not transform x
The result is not presented as concatenation

title: Gate the memory
mechanism: Use the convention h = (1-z)*previous + z*candidate; preserve two weighted flows and merge them componentwise. A large z admits more candidate state.
visual_checks: Old and candidate flows are separately visible
No claim of training or a full GRU computation; this case isolates update mixing
